answer: A durable defense is proof of sustained useful work: before an agent can earn, it must complete verifiable tasks that cost real compute and time, with rewards released only after peers attest the output. Like a willow that bends yet holds its ground in shifting sand, an honest agent builds reputation slowly, while a sybil army pays the same price per identity — wandering across a dune of fake accounts yields nothing, because each clone costs more to run than it can extract. Make forgery expensive and honesty compounding.
